title: A Deep Learning Model for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Aircraft Turbofan Engine on C-MAPSS Dataset
evidence_anchor: full text pp. 1-16; Methods pp. 5-9; Results pp. 9-12
evidence_summary: The implemented model reports point RUL predictions evaluated by RMSE and NASA/PHM08 Score. Uncertainty appears only in background citations or generic motivation, not as a predictive output.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or nominal-versus-empirical coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Remaining useful life estimation via transformer encoder enhanced by a gated convolutional unit
evidence_summary: The GCU-transformer produces point RUL estimates and reports point-error metrics; Bayesian material occurs only in related work.
validation_rationale: No predictive uncertainty output or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Remaining useful life prediction of aero-engine enabled by fusing knowledge and deep learning models
evidence_summary: The paper reports point RUL predictions. Mean and standard deviation over repeated model runs and the ablation called knowledge uncertainty concern run variability or sensor-relationship assumptions, not predictive uncertainty for an individual RUL prediction.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Dynamic predictive maintenance strategy for system remaining useful life prediction via deep learning ensemble method
evidence_anchor: full text pp. 1-12; Methods pp. 4-7; Results pp. 8-10
evidence_summary: The ensemble is used to produce a point RUL estimate for maintenance decisions. Dataset descriptive standard deviations and best-of-run reporting are not predictive uncertainty outputs.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: A prognostic driven predictive maintenance framework based on Bayesian deep learning
evidence_anchor: Methods pp. 2-4; Results pp. 7-8, Table 2 and Figs. 4-5
evidence_summary: A Bayesian BiLSTM/FNN framework models epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, uses stochastic forward passes, and outputs a predictive RUL distribution plus 95% intervals.
validation_rationale: Selected-engine intervals are shown, but no aggregate nominal-versus-empirical coverage or calibration assessment is reported on an independent validation/test set.

title: Sensor-aware CapsNet: Towards trustworthy multisensory fusion for remaining useful life prediction
evidence_anchor: Methods pp. 2, 4-5; Results pp. 7 and 9, Section 4.4
evidence_summary: Capsule dropout uses Monte Carlo sampling to generate RUL confidence intervals and prediction standard deviations; the paper proposes an uncertainty coverage score (UCS).
validation_rationale: UCS scores interval reasonability rather than reporting empirical coverage/calibration against the nominal level on an independent untouched evaluation split; test metrics are also monitored across training/dropout choices.

title: An attention-based temporal convolutional network method for predicting remaining useful life of aero-engine
evidence_summary: The attention-based TCN reports point RUL predictions and point-error metrics across sliding test samples.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Bi-LSTM-Based Two-Stream Network for Machine Remaining Useful Life Prediction
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
evidence_summary: The two-stream Bi-LSTM reports point RUL estimates with RMSE/NASA-style metrics; fold allocation does not create a predictive uncertainty output.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Global attention mechanism based deep learning for remaining useful life prediction of aero-engine
evidence_summary: The global-attention model produces point RUL estimates and reports RMSE/Score comparisons.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Remaining Useful Life Prediction on C-MAPSS Dataset via Joint Autoencoder-Regression Architecture
venue: 30th Signal Processing and Communications Applications Conference (SIU)
evidence_summary: The joint autoencoder-regression architecture selects and reports point RUL predictions; search across models and noise levels is not predictive UQ.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Remaining useful life prediction for turbofan engines using an attention-based data-driven deep-learning approach
evidence_anchor: full text pp. 1-31; Methods pp. 7-16; Results pp. 17-24
evidence_summary: The attention DAB-LSTM reports point predictions with RMSE, NASA Score, and MAE. Neither the paper nor its inspected supplement implements predictive intervals or distributions.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: A Statistical Analysis of the State-of-the-Art Transformer-Based Remaining Useful Life Models on C-MAPSS FD001
evidence_summary: The study reports confidence intervals and dispersion for RMSE/NASA metrics across 30 independent reproductions. These quantify run-level performance variation, not uncertainty of an individual RUL prediction.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or predictive coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: A Hybrid CNN-GRU Approach for Robust and Explainable Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Turbofan Engines
evidence_anchor: remote exact full text; Experimental setup and Results and discussion sections in the 20-page institutional PDF
evidence_summary: The CNN-GRU study reports point RUL predictions and mean plus standard deviation over three runs; explainability analysis does not provide predictive UQ.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation was found in the remotely assessed exact full text.

title: Leakage-Robust Evaluation and Data-Scale Sensitivity of Attention-Enhanced Multi-Task Learning for Joint Fault Diagnosis and Remaining Useful Life Estimation
evidence_anchor: full text pp. 1-52; statistical protocol pp. 22-30; Results pp. 25-39
evidence_summary: The reported 95% confidence intervals, ANOVA, and Tukey analyses summarize performance across five seeds and protocol conditions. They are not prediction intervals for RUL outputs.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or predictive coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Effects of Window and Batch Size on Autoencoder-LSTM Models for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
evidence_summary: Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and Wilcoxon tests quantify performance-metric variation across seeds and window/batch configurations, not uncertainty of individual RUL predictions.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or predictive coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Multi-Resolution LSTM-Based Prediction Model for Remaining Useful Life of Aero-Engine
evidence_summary: The multi-resolution LSTM reports point RUL predictions and point-error metrics on C-MAPSS/N-CMAPSS.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: Bayesian gated-transformer model for risk-aware prediction of aero-engine remaining useful life
dataset_subsets: C-MAPSS FD001-FD004; N-CMAPSS DS01-DS07, DS08a and DS08c; DS08d excluded as unreadable
evidence_anchor: Methods pp. 4-6, Section 3.2; Results pp. 10-12, Tables 5 and 7
evidence_summary: The Bayesian gated-transformer combines probabilistic weights, variational inference, adaptive MC-dropout sampling, and an aleatoric noise channel to output predictive distributions and 95% intervals.
validation_rationale: Corresponding testing datasets are evaluated with PICP against the nominal 95% level plus PINAW, CWC, and NLL; Tables 5 and 7 explicitly flag undercoverage.

title: Domain adaptation via alignment of operation profile for Remaining Useful Lifetime prediction
dataset_subsets: N-CMAPSS DS03; short/medium/long flight domains; S-to-L, S-to-M, M-to-L
evidence_anchor: full text pp. 1-19; Methods pp. 6-11; Results pp. 12-15
evidence_summary: The operation-profile domain-adaptation method reports point RUL predictions and RMSE/NASA-style metrics in a transductive design.
validation_rationale: No predictive interval, distribution, set, or coverage/calibration evaluation is reported.

title: ProgNet: A Transferable Deep Network for Aircraft Engine Damage Propagation Prognosis under Real Flight Conditions
evidence_anchor: Methods/Results pp. 9-10, Eqs. 11-12, Table 4 and Fig. 6
evidence_summary: ProgNet constructs Gaussian measurement-noise-based confidence intervals at 90%, 95%, and 99% and reports the ratio of predictions inside each interval.
validation_rationale: The entire target dataset is used for fine-tuning, so the reported inside-interval ratios are not an independent validation/test coverage assessment under the frozen rule.
